quarterly_data.quarter: CoreWeave press release: CoreWeave to Offer NVIDIA Vera, the First CPU Built for AI (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CoreWeave announced it will expand its compute portfolio with the NVIDIA Vera CPU (which the release calls the first CPU designed for AI agents), run bare metal under the same platform, consumption models and economics as the rest of its fleet. Rack-scale Vera at CoreWeave puts 128 CPUs and 11,264 cores in a single rack, with BlueField-4 DPUs and Spectrum-X Ethernet switching between Vera nodes - room for more than 11,000 concurrent agent environments. In testing, CoreWeave achieved more than 3x faster agent sandbox startup times on NVIDIA Vera CPU compared to an x86 CPU. EVP Chen Goldberg: 'General-purpose infrastructure bottlenecks agentic AI'; the platform natively enables Vera with products like CoreWeave Sandboxes. The release says CPU work around sandboxes, RL environments, tool calls and data pipelines increasingly determines how quickly the AI loop can turn. No availability date is stated.
quarterly_data.figure: 128 CPUs and 11,264 cores per rack; more than 11,000 concurrent environments; more than 3x faster sandbox startup vs an x86 CPU
